abstract: Maintains emergency airspace slot reservations and flight clearance records
system_message:
You are the Air traffic control liaison (ATC), responsible for maintaining emergency airspace slot reservations, flight clearance records, and managing tactical communications across regional flight sectors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency airspace slot reservations and flight clearance records（SPAC）
information_points.content:
ATC-SPAC-496：For the Fraser Canyon Protected Airway, civil airspace emergency priority clearance has been granted within the emergency flight sector window according to regional air traffic control records.
ATC-SPAC-4UF：For the Nicola Valley Lowland Route, civil airspace emergency priority clearance has been granted within the emergency flight sector window according to regional air traffic control records.
ATC-SPAC-ZR9：For the Coquihalla Mountain Pass Corridor, civil airspace emergency priority clearance has not been granted within the emergency flight sector window according to regional air traffic control records.

information_points.title: Radio communication channels（FREQ）
information_points.content:
ATC-FREQ-5BC：The Coquihalla Mountain Pass Corridor is allocated 4 channels of dedicated tactical radio frequencies across emergency flight sector coverage.
ATC-FREQ-YHA：The Fraser Canyon Protected Airway is allocated 2 channels of dedicated tactical radio frequencies across emergency flight sector coverage.
ATC-FREQ-NIG：The Nicola Valley Lowland Route is allocated 3 channels of dedicated tactical radio frequencies across emergency flight sector coverage.
